title: run

task.description: Task or workflow name executed in this run.

role.description: Operational role of the actor (e.g., discovery, verifier).

model.description: Model identifier used by the run, or none.

scheduled_at.description: UTC timestamp when the run was scheduled to start.

started_at.description: UTC timestamp when the run actually started, or null if missed.

finished_at.description: UTC timestamp when the run finished, or null if missed or incomplete.

input_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the repository input state.

output_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA produced by the run, if any.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the prompt template used by the run.

configuration_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the task configuration used by the run.

engine_version.description: Engine version constant active during the run.

window.description: Optional time window covered by the run.

from.description: Inclusive UTC start timestamp of the covered time window.

to.description: Inclusive UTC end timestamp of the covered time window.

anyOf.description: Time window covered by a scheduled or manual run.

queries.description: Private list of search or investigative queries executed.

sources_consulted.description: Private list of sources or URLs consulted during the run.

estimated_cost.description: Estimated monetary or unit cost of the run.

message.description: Detailed error message (private by default if sensitive).

sensitive.description: When true, the error message is stripped from public projections.

stage.description: Optional pipeline or task stage where the error occurred.

items.description: Structured error entry recorded during a run.

status.description: Terminal or missed status of the run.

slot_id.description: Optional scheduled slot identifier for missed-run reconciliation.

notes.description: Optional operational notes for private diagnostics.

description: Authoritative private run manifest for scheduled tasks, Actions, and code agents.
